title: Jr. System Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
SDS is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, Linux/Unix, and infrastructure engineering. The ideal candidate will set up and maintain server environments, implement automation, support GitLab pipelines, manage firewalls, and handle core Linux systems. This role requires working fully in the US shift (CT Time).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and manage virtualized environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
* Set up, configure, and maintain Linux/Unix servers including Davian-based systems.
* Administer MySQL databases at a basic to intermediate level.
* Implement and manage automation tools such as Puppet.
* Support GitLab (repositories, permissions, runners, and pipelines).
* Deploy new servers and configure firewalls and network rules.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to support CI/CD and automation efforts.
* Document processes, maintain system standards, and implement improvements.
* Operate fully in the US (CT) shift.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–6+ years of experience as a Systems Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer.
* Strong experience with Linux/Unix systems administration.
* Hands-on experience in virtualization technologies (VMware/Hyper-V).
* Experience setting up and maintaining firewalls and server infrastructure.
* Knowledge of GitLab and version control workflows.
* Basic experience with MySQL database administration.
* Experience with Puppet or similar automation tools.
* Ability to work 100% in US Shift (Central Time).

**Preferred Skills**

* AWS experience or certification.
* DevOps exposure (CI/CD, pipelines, automation).
* Scripting experience (Bash, Python).
* Networking fundamentals (routing, switching, firewalls).

**Smart Data Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

title: Data and AI Knowledge Engineer - Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Data and AI Knowledge Engineer will prepare, organize, govern, and operate the structured and unstructured information required by the firm’s AI applications. The role is accountable for creating reliable pipelines, retrieval structures, metadata, quality controls, and lineage so AI solutions operate from current, permission-aware, and authoritative information.
  
  
This is not primarily a reporting or data-analyst role. The successful candidate must be capable of engineering data and knowledge systems that support enterprise AI, automation, analytics, and traceable decision support.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Data and knowledge architecture**

* Inventory and profile structured databases, SharePoint repositories, document libraries, APIs, Dataverse tables, and other approved data sources.
* Establish authoritative-source hierarchies and identify duplicate, conflicting, outdated, or incomplete content.
* Design data models, taxonomies, metadata, indexes, and knowledge structures.
* Work with practice SMEs to define content labels, business terminology, document types, effective dates, service categories, industries, and other contextual metadata.

**Data pipelines and integration**

* Develop ingestion, transformation, enrichment, synchronization, and archival pipelines.
* Build data-quality checks, reconciliation routines, and exception monitoring.
* Integrate data across Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Dataverse, SQL, SharePoint, and external APIs.
* Maintain lineage between source information, transformed content, retrieval indexes, and downstream AI responses.
* Establish refresh schedules and stale-content detection.

**Retrieval engineering**

* Configure Azure AI Search and other approved knowledge-retrieval services.
* Develop chunking, segmentation, embedding, metadata-filtering, hybrid-search, and reranking approaches.
* Test retrieval precision, completeness, ranking, citation traceability, and permission behavior.
* Optimize indexes for quality, speed, cost, and maintainability.
* Support AI engineers with representative evaluation and regression datasets.

**Data governance and operations**

* Implement technical controls for data classification, sensitivity, permission trimming, retention, deletion, and access.
* Support source-owner approvals and periodic content revalidation.
* Monitor data-pipeline health, index freshness, source availability, and quality exceptions.
* Develop Power BI reporting for data quality, solution usage, value, cost, and operational performance.
* Document schemas, metadata, lineage, data ownership, business rules, and known quality limitations.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Advanced SQL and relational data modeling.
* Python for data processing, automation, and quality validation.
* Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or comparable pipeline technologies.
* Azure AI Search, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, embeddings, metadata filtering, and reranking.
* Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure Data Lake, and SQL platforms.
* APIs, file ingestion, ETL and ELT patterns, and event-based synchronization.
* Power BI semantic modeling and operational reporting.
* Data lineage, data quality, master data, taxonomy, metadata, retention, and security concepts.
* Row-level and object-level security, sensitivity handling, and access-control testing.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1-2 or more years in data engineering, information architecture, search engineering, analytics engineering, or related disciplines.
* Experience preparing unstructured content for AI or enterprise search.
* Experience supporting retrieval-augmented generation applications.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, SharePoint, Dataverse, and Power BI.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.
* Familiarity with document-management, records-management, and knowledge-management practices.

**Success Measures**

* Data-source availability and pipeline reliability.
* Retrieval precision and completeness.
* Index freshness and stale-content rate.
* Data-quality exception volume and resolution.
* Source-to-response traceability.
* Permission and access-control test performance.
* Reuse of common data models, taxonomies, and ingestion patterns.
* Reduction in duplicate or conflicting knowledge.
* Completeness of lineage, metadata, and ownership documentation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role ensures information is technically ready for AI use. Business and practice data owners remain accountable for determining authoritative content, approving permitted uses, resolving substantive conflicts, and maintaining the source information.
